title: Robust Residual Correction via Selective Deployment for Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2512.22428v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Post-hoc residual correction can reduce forecasting error, but always-on updates often fail to generalize: when residual signals are weak or noisy, expressive correctors can overfit and even increase the overall forecasting errors. We introduce CRC, a robust residual correction framework that couples a hybrid corrector with a validation-calibrated selective deployment rule. CRC proposes corrections via a conservative ridge "floor" plus conditional nonlinear refinement, but deploys them only when held-out evidence indicates net error reduction over a frozen baseline forecaster. CRC treats when to revise a forecast as a validation-calibrated deployment decision, not only how to fit residuals. Across standard long-sequence benchmarks and multiple backbones, CRC improves horizon-averaged MSE and MAE in most dataset-backbone pairs, with particularly large gains on complex datasets (e.g., over 20% relative MSE reduction on Traffic). translated_title: 基于选择性部署的鲁棒残差校正时间序列预测方法
translated_abstract: 事后残差校正可以降低预测误差，但持续开启的更新往往难以泛化：当残差信号微弱或充满噪声时，表达能力强的校正器可能会过拟合，甚至增大整体预测误差。我们提出了CRC，一个鲁棒的残差校正框架，它将混合校正器与经过验证集校准的选择性部署规则相结合。CRC通过保守的岭回归“底线”加上条件性非线性精炼来生成校正，但只有在留出数据证据表明相对于冻结的基线预测器能够净减少误差时才部署这些校正。CRC将“何时修正预测”视为一个经验证集校准的部署决策，而不仅仅是“如何拟合残差”。在标准长序列基准测试和多个骨干模型上，CRC在大多数数据集-骨干模型组合中提升了对齐平均的MSE和MAE，在复杂数据集上收益尤为显著（例如，在Traffic数据集上相对MSE降低超过20%）。
tldr: CRC框架通过验证集校准的选择性部署规则，仅在校正能带来净误差降低时才应用混合残差校正，从而在时间序列预测中实现鲁棒的误差降低，尤其在复杂场景下避免了过拟合问题。
en_tdlr: CRC is a robust residual correction framework that deploys hybrid corrections only when validation-calibrated evidence indicates net error reduction, improving time series forecasting while avoiding overfitting from always-on updates.
